findings_for_the_activation_step.topic: T07 text 不复制不相关实体示例 vs the measured dependency graph
findings_for_the_activation_step.finding: The upstream demo entities cannot simply be dropped. entgo's production packages field, filter and sorting import entgo/ent, and entgo/ent imports the menu and user example entities; go list -deps on the repository's own code already shows entgo/ent, ent/menu, ent/user, ent/migrate and ent/predicate in the live graph today. rule/tenant_mutation_test.go additionally imports ent/enttest and ent/user, and deleting a mandatory tenant test is forbidden. Under the plan's own rule 按必要 package 及完整关联闭包复制, the demo ent client is therefore a required closure member; only ent/hook, ent/privacy, ent/runtime and ent/schema are unreachable and excluded.
findings_for_the_activation_step.impact: Records why 30 of the 104 activated files are upstream example-adjacent generated code, so the acceptance reviewer does not read them as scope creep.

findings_for_the_activation_step.finding: Three activated packages (entgo root, entgo/cache and their dependents) import github.com/tx7do/go-utils/trans. trans was already activated in T02, so leaving these on the module path would keep the retired dependency alive in the entry-point graph. The import map therefore maps the exact package github.com/tx7do/go-utils/trans to go-wind-admin/pkg/localdeps/go-utils/trans. The go-utils module root is deliberately NOT mapped, because fieldmaskutil, id, mapper and stringcase stay on the old path until groups B.
findings_for_the_activation_step.impact: Prevents a regression where T07 would silently re-introduce the T02 dependency.

findings_for_the_activation_step.finding: The staged tests' only test-only external imports are github.com/alicebob/miniredis/v2, github.com/stretchr/testify/{assert,require} and google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protojson, all already locked by go.mod (miniredis v2.39.0, testify v1.12.1). Redis is served in-process by miniredis, so no Redis service is needed.
findings_for_the_activation_step.impact: Activation in this round needs no go.mod/go.sum edit, keeping the module-file-unchanged gate intact.
